statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit of all public page archetypes found: landing notice, privacy policy, cookie policy, and unknown-route recovery. Not covered: ad-serving behavior on third-party publisher sites, because no such flow is reachable from this public notice.

paths.description: Public domain-purpose notice and only landing-page template; tested as the primary reading and contact journey.
Privacy Policy, representing the long-form policy template and privacy claims.
Cookie Policy, representing long tables, consent claims, and the second policy route.
Unknown-route recovery probe used to inspect HTTP and user-facing error behavior.

findings.summary: The fixed dark palette does not follow the user color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark and normal screenshots are byte-identical, while DOM evidence reports color-scheme: normal and no preference-driven theme CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven light and dark surface tokens using prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.evidence: The feature probe found no view-transition CSS; the site has two same-origin policy links that navigate between document views.
findings.suggestedFix: Add @view-transition { navigation: auto } with a reduced-motion-safe fallback for same-origin policy navigation.

findings.summary: Long policy pages provide no scroll-aware orientation.
findings.evidence: Privacy and cookie documents are 5,327px and 7,852px tall on mobile, while DOM/CSS inspection finds no sticky or scroll-state-aware chrome.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight sticky policy header or reading-progress treatment that responds to scroll position.

findings.summary: The long policies lack in-page navigation and attention cues.
findings.evidence: The policy DOM contains many numbered sections but no table of contents or fragment links, forcing linear scrolling through pages over 5,000px tall.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a semantic table of contents with fragment links and visible target highlighting for each numbered section.

findings.summary: The Cookie Policy table breaks mobile reflow.
findings.evidence: At 360px, the layout primitive measured scrollWidth 770px and horizontalOverflowPx 410; the mobile screenshot shows the long document constrained by wide tabular content.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap policy tables in a labelled overflow region or transform rows into responsive cards, while preserving table semantics.

findings.summary: Cold-load LCP is just outside the good threshold in Lighthouse.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured FCP and LCP at 2.6s, although the direct trace measured LCP at 1.46s; TBT and CLS were both zero.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce the render-path dependency on the external font stylesheet and verify field LCP after deployment.

findings.summary: A third-party font stylesheet dominates the critical path.
findings.evidence: HAR evidence shows the parser-inserted Google Fonts stylesheet at VeryHigh priority took 1,020ms; first-party CSS and SVG also lacked cache headers.
findings.suggestedFix: Self-host only the used font subset or use a system fallback, preload the actual critical font when justified, and add durable cache headers to versioned assets.

findings.summary: The primary content has no main landmark and the homepage has no h1.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed landmark-one-main; rendered DOM uses a section and three h3 elements on the homepage, with no main or h1.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap primary content in main and promote the page topic to one descriptive h1, retaining sequential headings below it.

findings.summary: Mobile zoom is explicitly disabled on every audited page.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed meta-viewport because user-scalable=no and maximum-scale=1 are present; both policy DOM snapshots repeat the restriction.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove user-scalable=no and the maximum-scale/minimum-scale restrictions so browser zoom remains available.

findings.summary: The logo omits intrinsic width and height attributes.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found the sole SVG has no width or height attributes, even though its rendered and natural size is 28x28; observed CLS was zero.
findings.suggestedFix: Add width="28" height="28" to reserve intrinsic space and keep the existing responsive CSS.

findings.summary: Policy pages reuse the homepage title and description.
findings.evidence: DOM evidence shows Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy both use title "Advertising Delivery and Code Integrity Notice" and the same domain-purpose description.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every policy route a unique title and accurate meta description matching its visible h1.

findings.summary: robots.txt is not a valid robots policy.
findings.evidence: The direct crawl probe returned HTTP 200 with body "empty OK" for robots.txt; Lighthouse failed its robots-txt audit with one error.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a valid text/plain robots.txt with at least a User-agent and Allow or Disallow directive, and reference the sitemap.

findings.summary: Indexing signals are incomplete and unknown routes return soft 404s.
findings.evidence: No canonical exists, sitemap.xml returns "empty OK", and an unknown route returned HTTP 200 with an empty body.
findings.suggestedFix: Add canonical URLs, publish a valid XML sitemap, and return a real 404 status for unknown routes.

findings.summary: The public organization notice has no share or entity metadata.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found zero JSON-LD blocks and no Open Graph metadata on the public domain-purpose page.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Organization JSON-LD and basic Open Graph title, description, image, and URL metadata.

findings.summary: Transport security policy is too weak for a public infrastructure domain.
findings.evidence: HTTPS and nosniff are present, but CSP is missing and HSTS is only max-age=1, which provides effectively no durable downgrade protection.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP and set HSTS to a meaningful duration after confirming all subdomains are HTTPS-ready.

findings.evidence: Header evidence found no frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Add frame-ancestors, a strict Referrer-Policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy appropriate to this static site.

findings.summary: Unknown URLs fail as blank successful pages.
findings.evidence: The unknown-route probe received responseStatus 200 and body text "empty OK", with no title, explanation, navigation, or recovery action.
findings.suggestedFix: Return an actual 404 document with a clear message, a home link, and correct HTTP status.

findings.summary: Privacy and cookie disclosures contradict each other and the observed site.
findings.evidence: The Privacy Policy says no analytics or profiling; the Cookie Policy says Google Analytics, Google Ads and Facebook targeting may be used, claims a first-visit consent banner that was absent, and contains the template residue "based on the sample you provided". The cookie probe observed zero cookies.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace template language with a single accurate data inventory, name actual processors and purposes, and implement the stated consent controls before any non-essential processing.

taskList.title: Restore mobile zoom and make policy tables reflow
Make privacy and cookie disclosures accurate and consistent
Add semantic page structure and long-document navigation
Return correct 404, robots, sitemap, canonical, and page metadata
Remove the font critical-path delay and cache static assets
Respect color preferences and add lightweight page transitions
